notes: Reader/TTS latency fix. Replaces the old first-phrase + whole-book-rest prefetch with a true double-buffered pipeline: text is split at punctuation into roughly 260-420 character speech chunks; while one chunk plays, only the next chunk is synthesized, and when playback switches the following chunk is immediately prefetched. This targets the reported 10-15 second silence between reader fragments. 0.8.6.24 somatic-hands, the confirmed 0.8.6.23 summon-duration fix, familiar FIX5/progression code, PRC_MULTISUMMON, and protected combat core 0.7.10.7 are unchanged.
